import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
import sklearn.metrics as mt

table = pd.read_csv('/data/diabeticos2.csv')
y = table['Tipo'].to_numpy(); X=table.drop(columns=['Tipo','G120','I120']).to_numpy()
NUM_TRIALS=10
rf_f1_macro=[]
for i in range(NUM_TRIALS):
    X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,stratify=y,test_size=0.2)
    cv_random = GridSearchCV(RandomForestClassifier(),{'n_estimators':[20],'criterion':['gini']},cv=5)
    cv_random.fit(X_train,y_train)
    pred = cv_random.predict(X_test)
    rf_f1_macro.append(mt.f1_score(y_test,pred,average='macro'))
print('mean', np.mean(rf_f1_macro))
